# Description

- These json files contain caches with bounding boxes for each ASCII character + some other most popular charecters for a number of font properties.
- These files are used to speed up text rendering to measure text offscreen in web workers without having to render it in DOM and then measure it by the browser.

# When used

- These files may be copied along with the report player build when `npm run build:reportPlayer` script is called.
- To rebuild these files you need to call the `TextDictionary.buildTextDictionary()` method, which is currently available for running from the `ServerReportPlayer/report-player-cef.html` sample.
- Due to the fact that the report player is used in different OS (Window and Linux) and by different clients (Pro and GE), these files will have to be generated by the client, who uses the build. See `report-player-cef.ts` file and `BuildFontsCache()` function for more explanation on how to build the caches and how to use them.
